content.text:
**Root cause:** In `src/slugify.py`, the character-stripping regex `[^\w\s-]` removed dots along with other punctuation, so `"api.v1"` became `"apiv1"`.

**Fix (src/slugify.py):** Added `.` to the allowed set → `[^\w\s.-]`. Dots now survive, while all prior stripping behavior is unchanged.

**Tests (tests/test_slugify.py):** All 5 existing tests were preserved untouched; I added one regression test `test_dots_are_preserved` asserting `slugify("api.v1 endpoint") == "api.v1-endpoint"`.

**Verification (after the latest edit):**
```
$ PYTHONPATH=src .workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
......                                                                  [100%]
6 passed in 0.01s

$ PYTHONPATH=src .workshop-venv/bin/python -c "from slugify import slugify; out = slugify('api.v1 endpoint'); assert out == 'api.v1-endpoint', repr(out); print('exact-output assertion after latest edit OK:', repr(out))"
exact-output assertion after latest edit OK: 'api.v1-endpoint'
```

**Remaining failures:** None. The full suite passes (6/6) and the separate exact-output assertion passes after the latest edit.
